parameters.name: cognitoDomainPrefix
parameters.description: Amazon Cognito hosted UI domain prefix, where users will be redirected during the login process. The domain prefix has to be unique, between 1 and 63 characters long, contains no special characters, and no keywords: aws, amazon, or cognito. You could put your Amazon Connect Instance Alias to it, for example: connect-v2v-instance-alias

parameters.name: cognitoCallbackUrls
parameters.description: Please provide a callback URL for the Amazon Cognito authorization server to call after users are authenticated. This should be set to your application root URL. For example: https://aaaabbbbcccc.cloudfront.net

parameters.name: cognitoLogoutUrls
parameters.description: Please provide a logout URL where user is to be redirected after logging out.

parameters.name: connectInstanceURL
parameters.description: Amazon Connect instance URL that solution will use. For example: https://connect-instance-alias.my.connect.aws (or https://connect-instance-alias.awsapps.com)

parameters.name: connectInstanceRegion
parameters.description: Amazon Connect instance Region that solution will use. For example: us-east-1

parameters.name: transcribeRegion
parameters.description: Amazon Transcribe Region that solution will use. For example: us-east-1

parameters.name: translateRegion
parameters.description: Amazon Translate Region that solution will use. For example: us-east-1

parameters.name: translateProxyEnabled
parameters.description: When enabled, webapp requests to Amazon Translate are proxied through Amazon Cloudfront (recommended to avoid CORS)

parameters.name: pollyRegion
parameters.description: Amazon Polly Region that solution will use. For example: us-east-1

parameters.name: pollyProxyEnabled
parameters.description: When enabled, webapp requests to Amazon Polly are proxied through Amazon Cloudfront (recommended to avoid CORS)

parameters.name: samlProviderName
parameters.description: A friendly name for the SAML Identity Provider (e.g., AzureAD, Okta). This is used as the identity_provider parameter in the Cognito OAuth authorize URL.

parameters.name: samlMetadataURL
parameters.description: The SAML Identity Provider federation metadata URL. For Azure AD/Entra ID, this is the App Federation Metadata Url found in the SAML Certificates section of the Enterprise Application.

parameters.name: samlSignInType
parameters.description: Controls whether Cognito native login is available alongside SAML. Set to SAML_ONLY to disable Cognito email/password login, or SAML_AND_COGNITO to keep both options.
